description: Defines the AccessTokenEntity class implementing OAuth2 access token logic, including token identification, expiry, client association, and scope management within the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin.

classes.name: AccessTokenEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 access token with methods for managing token data, expiry, client, and scopes.

methods.name: setPrivateKey
methods.description: Method stub for setting a private key, ignored as JWT is not used.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns an encrypted string representation of the token identifier.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the token's expiry date and time.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time, overriding to UTC and adding TTL.

methods.name: getUserIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the associated user identifier, if any.

methods.name: setUserIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the user identifier associated with the token.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client entity associated with the token.

methods.name: setClient
methods.description: Associates a client entity with the token.

methods.name: addScope
methods.description: Adds a scope to the token.

methods.name: getScopes
methods.description: Retrieves all scopes associated with the token.
